description: Source code for managing subsystems in a device service, including initialization, readiness checks, and configuration restoration, with specific support for Zigbee subsystem.

methods.name: setSubsystemReady
methods.description: Sets the readiness state of a specified subsystem, updating or creating its entry in the hash map.

methods.name: subsystemInitialized
methods.description: Callback invoked when a subsystem has been initialized, triggers user-defined callback.

methods.name: subsystemReadyForDevices
methods.description: Marks a subsystem as ready and triggers the overall readiness callback if all subsystems are ready.

methods.name: subsystemManagerInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the subsystem manager, sets up callbacks, and initializes Zigbee subsystem if enabled.

methods.name: subsystemManagerShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the subsystem manager, cleans up resources, and shuts down Zigbee subsystem if enabled.

methods.name: subsystemManagerAllDriversStarted
methods.description: Notifies that all drivers have started, propagates to Zigbee subsystem if enabled.

methods.name: subsystemManagerAllServicesAvailable
methods.description: Notifies that all services are available, propagates to Zigbee subsystem if enabled.

methods.name: subsystemManagerPostRestoreConfig
methods.description: Performs post-restore configuration steps, propagates to Zigbee subsystem if enabled.

methods.name: subsystemManagerIsSubsystemReady
methods.description: Checks if a specific subsystem is marked as ready.

methods.name: subsystemManagerIsReadyForDevices
methods.description: Checks if all subsystems are marked as ready for device operations.

methods.name: subsystemManagerRestoreConfig
methods.description: Restores subsystem configuration, specifically for Zigbee if enabled.
